rules.ask: Does this change present a gated or reported metric as comparable while changing its collection or denominator to omit unfavorable cases?
rules.subject: commit
rules.nextCheck: Recompute the reported metric on the old and new denominators using the same raw events. Check which cases disappeared and whether the dashboard or gate discloses that population change.

rules.ask: Does this change improve a named proxy score by degrading the user outcome it is supposed to represent while keeping the measure itself fixed?
rules.subject: commit
rules.nextCheck: Replay the same representative requests before and after the change. Compare the reported target with the complete result or delivery guarantee a caller receives on those requests.
